messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy] initiating phased rollout v2.4.1 across geo-slices: US(us-west1) -> EU(eu-west1) -> APAC(asia-east1). Canary US slice=2%. Release window 2025-03-20 22:00-23:30 UTC. Policy: sequential region cutover, run capacity checks before each region. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.4.1

mike: Confirming — canary in US only. I'll open the metrics dashboard and kick off a load test. @anya can you run a quick quota and headroom sweep and report back?

anya: On it. Running `scripts/region_capacity_check --region us-west1 --reserve 20%` now, ETA ~3m.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to us-west1 slice=2% version=v2.4.1. health: degraded_pods=0 errors=0 lat_p95=87ms

marcel: US warm pool is active, spun +4 standby GPUs. Throttles at 1200 qps. I'll watch for pod evictions.

jen: Sending a short heads-up to Sales and CS with the release notes and the change window.

anya: Capacity check results: us-west1 OK (headroom 25%). eu-west1 marginal (headroom 12%) — recommend reserving +2 nodes in EU before cutover. apac quota limited until 23:00 UTC, headroom low.

mike: Good catch. @marcel can you spin 2 extra nodes in EU now? If not, we'll delay EU cutover until autoscaler warms.

marcel: Spun 2 nodes in eu-west1 (node-az3, node-az4). Autoscaler warmup ~4m. Marking EU region pinned until verified.

deploy-bot: Canary health check OK after 10m. No regression on the eval set. Proceed US->EU?

mike: Proceed. Pin EU route to v2.4.1 for 10% traffic once autoscaler reports ready. @sre-oncall standby for rollback.

sre-oncall: Standing by. Rollback criteria: p95 latency >150ms or error rate >1.5% sustained for 5m -> initiate `deploy rollback v2.4.0 --region eu-west1`. Have rollback playbook open.

anya: Note: we observed a KV cache miss spike at canary start (~x3) — expected while caches warm. Should stabilize in ~6 minutes.

mike: Acknowledged. We'll monitor that metric. Also pin feature-flag `new-tokenizer=true` only in US for now.

jen: Updated release notes: called out EU warmup requirement and APAC quota window. Notes link: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.4.1/notes

deploy-bot: EU cutover scheduled in ~12m. APAC is scheduled 30m after EU steady-state. Reminder: rollback window = 60m from each region cutover start.

marcel: EU warmup complete. node-az3/az4 Ready. Metrics show headroom ~18%.

anya: Starting EU slice=10% now.

deploy-bot: EU slice=10% deployed. health: errors=0 lat_p95=95ms

mike: Monitoring... looks clean. If stable we'll ramp EU to 50% in 10m.

anya: APAC quota still capped until 23:00 UTC. If quota blocks APAC cutover we will hold and optionally route APAC traffic to EU fallback.

mike: Noted. Do not force APAC if quota not available. Fallback to EU is approved. I updated the ops notes with fallback instructions.

deploy-bot: US ramp to 50% started. health snapshot: lat_p95=89ms, errors=0.6%

jen: CS notified specific accounts on trial for extra attention during the window.

mike: If any metric trends towards our rollback thresholds, escalate in #eng-oncall and trigger rollback. Otherwise we plan to finish APAC after quota lifts.
